item.description:
The rescue was only the beginning, but what came after deserves to be told too.

‘Beyond Society’ is the new Netflix documentary series created by J.A. Bayona and Carlos Torres, bringing together, for the first time, the testimonies of those who survived and the families of those who never returned.

An intimate look at what happened after the rescue, the stories that were left untold, and the lives that moved forward, forever marked by that experience.

‘Beyond Society’ arrives on Netflix on December 18.

item.title: [Netflix] The Final Problem | Official Trailer | Netflix
item.description:
An isolated hotel. A mysterious death. Thirteen guests under suspicion. And only one person capable of solving the enigma. The game is afoot! The Final Problem is the period mystery thriller starring Jose Coronado, María Valverde, Martiño Rivas and Maribel Verdú, based on the novel by Arturo Pérez-Reverte. Premieres September 25, only on Netflix.

Spring, 1959. A storm cuts off a small island near Mallorca. At the hotel where the guests take shelter, Elisa Mander, a quiet English tourist, is found dead. What looks like a suicide soon turns out to be something far more disturbing: a murder.

Basil (Jose Coronado), a retired actor who once played Sherlock Holmes on the big screen, is drawn — almost against his will — into unravelling what happened. Alongside Adela Figueroa (María Valverde) and Foxá (Martiño Rivas), he searches the halls of the luxurious hotel for answers, testing the composure of the hotel's manager, Mrs. Ausländer (Maribel Verdú).

In a place no one can leave and no one can reach, every guest and every member of staff becomes a suspect in a crime that grows more complex by the minute.

The cast is completed by Gonzalo de Castro, Cristina Kovani, Jose Condessa and Pepón Nieto, among others. Directed by Félix Viscarret, The Final Problem arrives on Netflix September 25.

item.title: [Sony Pictures] THE SOCIAL RECKONING – New Trailer (4K)
item.description:
The verdict is in. The reckoning is coming.

The Social Reckoning, a companion piece to The Social Network, is coming exclusively to theatres October 9.


Inspired by true events and the whistleblower who started the social media reckoning we’re seeing play out today, this Aaron Sorkin original screenplay is a companion piece to the hit film The Social Network and a true David and Goliath story. Frances Haugen (Madison), a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz (White), a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network’s most guarded secrets.

item.title: [Sony Pictures] GHOST SOLDIER - Official Trailer | (4K) Starring Jim Caviezel
item.description:
He’s not a threat, he’s a guarantee. Jim Caviezel defends the defenseless in GHOST SOLDIER - coming soon exclusively to movie theatres. #GhostSoldierMovie

In the action-thriller Ghost Soldier, Jim Caviezel stars as Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald, a solitary man with a mysterious past, living a quiet life off the grid in his hometown. But when a powerful foreign corporation descends on his community determined to seize his and his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz takes action — he’s actually a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with weapons no one has ever seen, a lifetime of lethal military training, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz becomes the one thing his enemies never anticipated: a one-man war they can’t win.
